dedupe_keys.name: global energy consumption of the mineral mining industry historical and pathways to 2060 university of leeds dataset

description: This dataset holds the input data and scripts behind the paper "Global energy consumption of the mineral mining industry: exploring the historical perspective and future pathways to 2060" (Global Environmental Change, 2023). The Research Data Leeds page lists a README (9 KB), an input data zip (about 2 MB) and a scripts zip (56 KB), deposited on 28 November 2023 by Emmanuel Aramendia, Paul E. Brockway, Peter G. Taylor and Jonathan B. Norman of the School of Earth and Environment and the School of Chemical and Process Engineering; material is under CC BY 4.0 unless the README states otherwise, and the files are free to download. Coverage is global mineral mining. Caveats: the page says some included datasets carry their own licences that must be checked before reuse, and the variables and scenarios are described in the README and paper, which were not read. For simulation it gives historical and projected energy use of mining to size the power and fuel demand of mines under future pathways. Related catalogue records include the Benguerir open-pit mine hourly energy data and the BGS world mineral statistics.
